home.title: The design system behind the next portfolio.
home.lead: Tokens, typography, surfaces and a reusable shell — built against real portfolio data so the system is proven before any public page depends on it.
home.typographyLead: One fluid scale drives every page. Headings are set tight; technical detail uses the mono register.
home.actionsLead: Every action renders the element its behaviour requires — a link navigates, a button acts. Status chips carry meaning through tokens, not colour alone.
home.evidenceLead: The card language future project and case-study pages will use. Every fact below is read from the canonical portfolio data.
home.capabilitiesLead: Recruiter evidence focuses, straight from the registry — the same data that drives the live recruiter surfaces.

about.title: How the system is built
about.lead: The rules the V3 design system holds itself to, and the data architecture underneath it.
about.principles.tokens: Components consume semantic tokens, never literal colours, so both themes can be designed rather than derived.
about.principles.semantics: Every control renders a real element. There are no simulated buttons and no placeholder links anywhere in the system.
about.principles.motion: Motion is state feedback only, in a 150–320 ms band, and no information ever depends on it.
about.principles.evidence: Visual effects never compete with portfolio evidence. Depth and accent are used to rank content, not to decorate it.
about.data.canonical: Canonical JSON is the single source of portfolio truth for both architectures.
about.data.generated: The legacy registry is generated from that JSON, so the live site keeps booting synchronously with no build step.
about.data.react: React imports the same JSON at build time, which is what lets these pages pre-render with real content.
